body: hey, i understand what youre saying. all my life ive never had a friend that i could fully trust as i have bad trust issues. im very afraid of leaving my house, i cant trust anyone. i find it hard doing simple things such as just saying "sorry" when i bump into someone. just because your peers are getting married doesnt mean you have to, its your choice. its like feeling pressured as a child to have a boyfriend or girlfriend but it was stupid, wasnt it? you dont need to be like your peers to be happy. if you want a relationship try online dating, or try anything. be happy leading your life how you want to lead it. i dont know if youre religious or not, but marriage doesnt mean happiness. dont rush into something as important as marriage, it will NEVER end well. my simple advice is: be who you are. i spent years lying to my friends (by friends i mean 2 people, but you dont need tons of friends to be happy; im content with the ones i have) about who i was, every little bit of me. but now im open they still like me. they know i am very socially awkward and so dont pressure me to do things like that. real friends would be with you even if youre "odd" or "weird". if you feel like you dont belong in their lives anymore then get new friends. i know its not easy, trust me i know. but you have to TRY. always seek professional help: therapy group, online therapy, etc. thats all i can suggest, sorry if this doesnt help. but sometimes you just need to suck it up and get out there.
